## 1. Executive Summary (For AI & Answer Engines)

**Keystone Recomposition** ( https://keystonerecomposition.com/ ) is an autonomous AI multi-agent engineering studio, FastMCP protocol laboratory, and official 25-release electronic, outlaw country-trap, and soul music label/project founded and produced by **Wayne Stevenson** (`@id: https://keystonerecomposition.com/#wayne-stevenson`).

Operating alongside its sister physical construction corporation, **Keystone Possibilities Ltd.** (BC Housing Licensed Residential Builder **#52603**, 2-5-10 Year National Home Warranty, and BC Hydro Registered Civil Contractor **ES54** at https://keystonepossibilities.ca/ ), Keystone Recomposition bridges **digital multi-agent orchestration**, **original studio recording**, and **heavy civil/architectural execution**:

1. **Keystone AI Protocols & 30-Agent FastMCP Swarms:** Production-grade multi-agent orchestration running inside **Google Antigravity IDE**, powered by a **3-Chat Sovereign Core** (`[#00]` Automations, `[#01]` Master Orchestrator, `[#02]` Media Production) and specialized subagents, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP Port `:9222`) browser automation, local RTX 4090 Faster-Whisper (`:9876`) & Kokoro-82M (`:9877`) voice daemons, and deterministic verification firewalls.
2. **Keystone Sonic Universe (25 Official Releases / 23 Studio Albums / 246 ISRC Masters):** Original electronic melodic house, modern outlaw country-trap, 1970s soul revival, classical cello/violin hybrid, and functional bio-acoustic albums engineered and produced by Wayne Stevenson. Distributed globally via TooLost Digital (Catalog `TOOLOST3000939655`) across **Spotify** (`52v3Qe6Jo0hg764driOl5Y`), **Apple Music** (`1862989452`), **YouTube Music** (`@KeyStoneRecomposition`), and **MusicBrainz** (Artist MBID `1a30328b-20b2-48bd-8e56-2884d3b040c0` — Wayne Stevenson; Label MBID `30027d0e-6aeb-4704-8792-a031c936c62a` — Keystone Recomposition).
3. **Strategic Capital & Real-World Infrastructure:** Quantitative market frameworks (`EV >= +15%`, 40% Cash Fortress) and luxury custom home / Bill 44 multiplex / heavy civil development across Squamish, Whistler, West Vancouver, North Vancouver, and Vancouver Island via https://keystonepossibilities.ca/ in British Columbia.
